text: Welcome to the Salted Gull! Best rum on the island. Only rum on the island, but still.
New face, eh? Pull up a barrel. What'll it be?

choices.text: What's out in the deep water?

text: Rumors? I've got a cellar full. Sailors swear there's {rumor}.
Can't promise it's still there, mind. Islands out here have a way of... moving.
Captain Morrow. "Red Tide", they call him. Holds a rock {redtide} - a fort on top, guns on the walls, black sails circling it like gulls.
Sink one of his ships and he takes it personal. Board his rock and you'd best bring friends. And a bigger boat.
Fella last week said he'd seen {rumor}. Paid in fish. I don't take fish.
And there's old talk of standing stones with writing nobody can read. Driftstones, Wren calls 'em. Wren also talks to crabs.
Fishing village, born and bred. Odile runs the dock, Ambrose keeps the light, and I keep everyone else from thinking too hard.
Quiet place. Too quiet, some say. The nets have been coming up empty, and the tide's been strange since spring.
Deep water? You mean the Sea King. Don't laugh. Fella in that corner lost a whole sloop to it, and he wasn't drinking. Much.
A serpent big as a ship, rises when a crew sails over its water. Bites the deck clean through. Here, I'll mark where he says it happened.
Jump when the tail comes up. That's all the advice anyone's lived to give.
Rum, stew, and a seat out of the rain. Brinehollow Black tastes like tar and regret. The stew tastes like stew.
Pay up front. Nessa taught me that one.

bye.text: Come back alive and I'll pour you something worth bragging about.
